Identification.LongTitle: An Act to amend the Historic Sites and Monuments Act (composition of the Board)
Identification.RunningHead: An Act to amend the Historic Sites and Monuments Act (composition of the Board)

Stages.StageText: Reprinted as amended by the Standing Committee on Environment and Sustainable Development as a working copy for the use of the House of Commons at Report Stage and as reported to the House on March 2, 2018

Provision.Text: This enactment amends the Historic Sites and Monuments Act to increase the number of members of the Historic Sites and Monuments Board of Canada and to provide for First Nations, Inuit and Métis representation on the Board. It also modifies the en­titlements of Board members.
Her Majesty, by and with the advice and consent of the Senate and House of Commons of Canada, enacts as follows:

Subsection.Text: The portion of subsection 4(1) of the Historic Sites and Monuments Act before paragraph (a) is replaced by the following:
There is established a Board, to be called the Historic Sites and Monuments Board of Canada, consisting of up to 19 members as follows:
Subsection 4(1) of the Act is amended by striking out "and" at the end of paragraph (c) and by replacing paragraph (d) with the following:

Paragraph.Label: (d)
Paragraph.Text: one representative — who may be a person referred to in any of paragraphs (a) to (c) or a person appointed under paragraph (e) — for each province or territory, to be appointed by the Governor in Council; and

Paragraph.Label: (e)
Paragraph.Text: one representative — who may be a person referred to in any of paragraphs (a) to (c) or a person appointed under paragraph (d) — for each of the following, to be appointed by the Governor in Council:

Subsection.Text: Section 4 of the Act is amended by adding the following after subsection (2):

Subsection.MarginalNote: Eligibility of appointed members — knowledge and experience
Subsection.Text: A person is not eligible to be appointed as a representative under paragraph (1)(d) or (e), unless that person has knowledge and experience relevant to the appointment that will assist with the business of the Board.
Subsections 5(1) and (2) of the English version of the Act are replaced by the following:
The Governor in Council shall designate one of the members of the Board to be its Chair.
The Board shall meet at least once in every calendar year at the call of the Chair, but the time and place of each meeting is subject to the approval of the Minister.
Subsection 5(4) of the Act is replaced by the following:
Ten members of the Board constitute a quorum.

Section.Text: Section 8 of the Act is replaced by the following:

Subsection.Text: Each member of the Board appointed by the Governor in Council is to be paid the remuneration that is fixed by the Governor in Council.

Members of the Board are to be paid, in accordance with Treasury Board directives, travel and living expenses incurred in connection with the business of the Board while absent from their ordinary place of residence.

The Chair of the Board and each member of the Board appointed by the Governor in Council are to be paid expenses fixed by the Governor in Council that are incurred for administrative assistance in connection with the business of the Board.
